arn.text: Taysir is a wizard of Rabiah who was copied only five times, once for each color, during the Thousandfold Refraction of Rabiah, and Nailah seduces the black Taysir and has him kill and absorb the green one.

Nailah wants the united Taysir to make her queen of all Rabiahs, and she tempts the Nomad to slay the Dervish, but he refuses and attacks her, and gravely wounded, he tells the Dervish to escape and find the last Taysir.

The Dervish and Raghib reach the castle of El-Hajjâj, where Raghib exposes the water as an illusion, and the Dervish merges with the Apprentice after Nailah kills El-Hajjâj and Raghib, becoming the complete Taysir.
After Taysir becomes a planeswalker, Nailah's seduction fails, and he blasts her and leaves, and she bars him from returning to any plane of Rabiah.

hml.text: In Homelands, Taysir tells Daria that Serra and Feroz are long dead but that their spirit survives so long as the Homelands do, and she acts as the scholar who mentors Daria.
He calls the werewolves the Baron's lieutenants, and he defeats Leshrac but cannot kill him and imprisons him deep in Phyrexia instead.
Taysir follows Sandruu to Ulgrotha, defeats and exiles him, and is then killed by Feroz, whom he had fought with an earthquake that destroyed the Anaba pictoglyph caves.
